harbor-fab.title: Harbor Fabrication
harbor-fab.headline: A schedule you can plan your life around.
harbor-fab.lede: Welders, fitters and machine operators at Harbor Fabrication are organizing with Lodge 412. Signing a card is confidential, it's protected by federal law, and it's how a union vote starts.
harbor-fab.issues_intro: We've talked with more than a hundred people at Harbor Fabrication. The same three things come up in almost every conversation.

issues.title: Overtime rules that change every week
issues.body: A new policy shows up on the break-room board most Thursdays. Nobody knows what next month's rules will be.

issues.title: Weekends announced the night before
issues.body: Mandatory Saturday shifts posted Friday at 9 p.m. make childcare, second jobs and family plans impossible.

issues.title: Safety questions with no written answer
issues.body: Ventilation in Bay 3 and the lockout procedure on the plasma table have been raised for a year, with no written response.

harbor-fab.quote: I don't need a raise this year. I need to know on Monday whether I'm working Saturday.
harbor-fab.quote_cite: Fitter, second shift, nine years at Harbor (name withheld)
